nodes.label: Memory Recall Premise
nodes.rationale: The LLM's job is memory recall, not prosody reasoning. No system prompt, no meter feet spelled out, no persona, enabling simple and minimal instructions.

nodes.label: Three-Stage Pipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Decoupling generation, validation, and thresholding saves API cost by ensuring that parser or threshold changes do not require re-calling the LLM.

nodes.label: run.py generate
nodes.rationale: Only stage touching the network. It saves raw response to disk and marks registry rows awaiting_validation.

nodes.label: run.py validate
nodes.rationale: Pure offline validation (JSON parsing, text comparison, pyarud scoring) that can be run repeatedly.

nodes.label: run.py threshold
nodes.rationale: Applies a pass/fail cutoff to stored pyarud scores without re-running generation or validation.

nodes.label: Registry
nodes.rationale: The single source of truth tracking per-verse status, token counts, and costs, ensuring input data remains unmodified.

nodes.label: Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Transitions verses from pending -> awaiting_validation -> scored -> passed, with failed transitions routing back to pending for next-pass generate.

nodes.label: Text Fidelity Check
nodes.rationale: Ensures LLM only adds diacritics and doesn't change underlying letters. Exact match comparison after normalization prevents creative fixes.

nodes.label: pyarud
nodes.rationale: External library used to score prosody of classical Arabic poem verses against labeled meters.
